name: Academic Excellence Scholarship
description: Awarded to students with a minimum 3.8 GPA who have demonstrated exceptional academic performance throughout high school.

name: STEM Innovation Grant
description: For students pursuing degrees in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics with a focus on innovative problem solving.

name: Community Leadership Award
description: Recognizing students who have led significant community service initiatives and demonstrated strong leadership qualities.

name: Arts & Humanities Foundation Scholarship
description: Supporting students who show outstanding promise in the visual or performing arts, or the study of human culture.

name: First-Generation Success Scholarship
description: Designed for students who are the first in their family to attend college and show high potential for success.

name: Future Educators Scholarship
description: For high-achieving students planning to pursue a career in K-12 education.

name: Varsity Scholar-Athlete Award
description: Awarded to a student-athlete who maintains a balance between high-level sports participation and academic achievement.

name: Entrepreneurial Spirit Scholarship
description: Recognizing students who have started their own small business or demonstrated significant entrepreneurial initiative.
